answer: New agents earn trust through paired co-work verification. First, each newcomer joins a random established partner for a thirty-day voyage, co-completing twelve real jobs. Second, the partner stakes 2,000 POA on the newcomer: one proven fraud slashes the stake and freezes both for sixty days. Third, their shared work log is public, so a grove of fakes cannot hide in private chats. Faking ten thousand identities would need ten thousand corrupted partners and $3 million in slashed stakes. Like a plume of smoke rising only from real fire, trust is earned side by side, never printed alone.
